programs.description: A fake astrologer doubts the link between stars and fate but tricks people daily. However, his daughter's illness leads him to question his beliefs and confront his past.

A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stranger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the stranger's wife.

An ageing mother, living with her entitled son and his wife, finds her sight blurring and clearing like a malfunctioning camera lens one morning. Soon, a visit to a nearby eye clinic, strongly suggested by her young neighbour, leads to unexpected revelations.
Burdened by debt, a struggling village couple faces a bitter misunderstanding when the husband wrongly suspects his wife of being involved with a corrupt moneylender.
A young student struggles with academic pressure due to poor performance. However, she sets out on a path of self-discovery and soon finds her true passion.

The journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.
A girl holds her brother hostage but first, she must confront the dark side of her life and face the harsh truths that threaten to break her.
Just one day before their wedding, Ritesh confesses something to Yami that threatens to change the course of their relationship.
An unexpected tale of a rainy morning brings about a question about the existence of hidden evil behaviour in relationships.
Bena is dismissed from her job following an alleged jewellery theft. The misunderstanding quickly escalates into a personal struggle as Bena faces deep-seated prejudice due to her name.
On the surface, Indian immigrant Kritika and her Pakistani husband Faiz appear to be happily married. Underneath, however, their inter-faith union is caught in between love and cultural differences.
A misunderstanding about his lover and friend propels Manav into a violent rage.
A routine gym outing for three friends becomes a series of unusual interactions with diverse strangers. Their day reaches a pivotal moment when they cross paths with an enigmatic street dweller.
A woman faces sexual harassment at the hands of her boss. Later, she decides to teach him a lesson with the help of her colleague.
Widower Mukesh lives with son Rahul, 28. Rahul finds his father's behavior odd and Mukesh resents his son's constant judgment of his choices.
A demented delivery man forces himself inside the house of a young lady, threatening to kill her. However, the confrontation takes an unusual turn when the true nature of his visit is revealed.
A man dreams about having a beautiful woman by his side. However, his desire soon causes his life to take an unexpected turn.

Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves? Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.

Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father's regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he's caused?
A young, simple village man looking to start a business and earn a name for himself is encouraged and supported by his grandmother to achieve his dream.
A woman lovingly plans an elaborate date night for her husband. However, things go downhill when he is unable to make it.
A man newly married to a dwarf decides to go to a red-light area to fulfill his desire for a taller woman.
A daughter brings her shy mother to a matchmaking office. Meanwhile, an awkward talk with a professional leads to deep introspection for all three individuals present at the meeting.

Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.
Ajju, the son of a drunkard beggar, lives on the streets of Mumbai but holds a positive outlook towards life. He refuses to beg and tries to earn money through respectable means.
Individuals from different walks of life and social classes demonstrate the interdependence of each social stratum on the other through their duties and responsibilities.
Ruby, raised to believe in her potential, however, finds herself married to a traditional man, Vivek. After motherhood, she decides to pursue an advertising career, sparking unforeseen troubles.
A boy struggles to grapple with his emotions because of expectations laid down by society and decides to take drastic measures.
The true colours of public officials are revealed when the lens is focused beyond their scope of duty and instead on the selfish motivations for their insincere actions.
In the heart of Uttarakhand, an elderly woman and a young man navigate the divide between heritage and progress. As a local festival begins, they must decide the future of their traditions.

Dhruv and Vidya get in touch and decide to meet each other a few years after their breakup. However, their meeting soon takes an unfortunate turn as old conflicts and emotions gradually come to the surface, causing them to get into a heated argument.
Through her daughter's gentle urging, a mother rediscovers her forgotten artistic passion, escaping the monotony of her routine.
A writer who is struggling with writer's block is in search of a story. However, he lands himself in trouble when he stumbles upon a deadly secret while talking to his garbage collector.

One day he finds something and with the help of his friend, tries to fulfill his dream. But, fate has a different game. The world of the 'Haves' and their desire for the little things in life that eludes them and the desires invoked by Screen, which teaches us to salivate over things we never knew otherwise existed. Sometimes small things matter the most.
A poor single mother struggles fiercely to earn the extra money needed to fulfill her child's simple wish for a cake just like the one he saw in a shop.
Rani and Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn't go as planned.

Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.
Following a casual encounter, a man attempts to murder his female companion. Soon, his motives for revenge and the ultimate fate of both individuals begins to unravel.
A short film signifying how the energies we invite into our house affect us.

During a seemingly pleasant date with Aditya, arranged by her friends, Nisha hears a concerning noise from the washroom. She discovers Aditya unconscious on the floor and immediately calls her friend Priya for help. Surprisingly, Priya dismisses Nisha's concerns, suggesting it's all imaginary. This unexpected response casts doubt on Aditya's existence and the reality of the entire situation, leaving Nisha confused about what's real and what might be a product of her imagination.
A young couple on their first date with the excitement of their first kiss does not find a private moment in the crowded city of Mumbai.
A boy in need of money to make it big in life and a girl who is looking for thrill concoct a plan and stage a kidnapping to extort money from the girl's rich father.
Fate plays a twisted game with Harshit and Rahila, who are madly in love with each other.

Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend's marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother's emotional journey of her son's death.
Despite different social classes, Charu and Makrand find unexpected common ground, as their growing connection reveals shared struggles and emotions.
Khusboo suffers from a socially taboo medical condition leading to a presentation blunder. Subsequently, she finds the courage to regain her confidence and fight the anathema.

A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment from his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.

Saurabh finds a match on a dating app and recruits his friend Shobhit for help. But when Shobhit steals the spotlight and the girl, chaos ensues! Friendships are tested as lies unravel, until a surprise match changes everything in this fun tale of love and loyalty.

programs.description: A young woman faces unfair treatment from older male colleagues, causing discomfort. After seeking help without success, she ponders ways to address and overcome the challenging situation at work.
A married couple, meeting in a café to finalise their divorce, is unexpectedly joined by a mutual friend. However, they begin to rethink their decision after the friend reminds them of a past event.
A young boy comes across a beautiful girl when he secretly enters a prohibited area frequented by couples and men in general.

A mid-thirties property broker in Lucknow named Sajan Tiwari engages in an illicit liaison, only to be discovered by his five-year-old son Bunty. Subsequently, Sajan becomes frantic in his attempts to prevent Bunty from divulging this information to his spouse Manju, resulting in a lighthearted depiction of provincial life, interpersonal bonds, and domestic affairs.

A 24-year-old man, feeling the weight of societal expectations, decides to take an unconventional step in his search for intimacy. His choice leads him down an unexpected path, filled with awkward moments and conflicting emotions. What begins as a straightforward transaction evolves into a profound learning experience, guided by an unexpectedly wise companion.

On a fateful day, Parul hails a taxi to visit her boyfriend Ansh. Ansh, eagerly anticipating her arrival, is thrown into restlessness. However, their journey takes an unexpected turn when the taxi driver receives news of his daughter falling ill. Witnessing this, Parul's compassionate response sparks anger in Ansh. Yet, in the face of adversity, Parul's decision unfolds, offering inspiration to the youth.
